title: Slack: one useful tip in a Friday channel
description: A busy #general-ops with lunch plans, sauna jokes and printer complaints, and one passing tip about RAD-233. Tests precision: exactly one item, bound to the instance only, no invented knowledge from the chatter.
subject: #general-ops

messages.text: happy friday!! who's up for lunch? 🍜
ramen again? I had it on Tuesday 😅
I'm in for anything, I'm still new so I don't know any good places yet. Kiitos for the invite!
come to the sauna on Thursday instead, much better introduction to the team
btw for whoever is at Sodankylä next. a soft reboot on RAD-233 hangs it since the 2.5 update, I've had to pull the power at the PDU twice now. so skip the reboot button
also the printer on the 2nd floor is dead again. Veikko please stop sending the big PDFs 😂

items.action: Pull the power at the PDU instead of using the soft reboot.
items.summary: Since the 2.5 update a soft reboot hangs RAD-233; power-cycle it at the PDU instead.
